item_title: Five years of Station Nord-03 corrections are now public
item_introduction: The archive explains every gap and every drift correction behind the Oslofjord water-quality series.

add_image.image_alt: The coastal observatory building on the shore
add_image.image_caption: Station Nord-03 at low tide. The archive covers every service visit since 2021.

add_paragraph: The water-quality series from **Station Nord-03** has been online since 2021, but until now the corrections behind it lived in a shared spreadsheet and a folder of photographs. The new archive publishes **412 service records** across nine sensors: reference comparisons, drift coefficients, firmware versions and the reason for every gap.

It is a deliberately unglamorous release. Each quality flag in the hourly series can now be traced to a specific visit — a scratched optical window, a logger reset, a calibration that failed its acceptance check. Reusers no longer have to take the flags on trust.
The archive is versioned on TerraNova Open Data and will be updated after each quarterly service. A README explains the file layout and the correction workflow.
